text:
Noah P.: heads up, trying the Python quickstart with a service token for a brand-new SSO org and the first request gets a 401, then retries 403 billing_required. weird chain.
Noah P.: minimal snippet i ran locally:
```python
import requests
resp = requests.post("https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat",
                     headers={"Authorization": "Bearer sk-test-zzzz"},
                     json={"model": "rw-mini-1", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "ping"}]})
print(resp.status_code, resp.text)
```
Noah P.: first run: `401 {"error":"invalid_token"}` after i re-ran with same token it returned `403 {"error":{"type":"billing_required","message":"workspace 7890 needs a payment method"}}`
Aisha (devex): thanks, that combo smells like a token propagation race in our auth cache + the console hiding the billing CTA for SSO-only orgs. does the org admin see anything under console.redwood.example/orgs/7890/billing?
Noah P.: admin opens billing page and there is no add-card button, only a help blurb: "Billing must be enabled by your company admin. Contact support."
Diego (sdk): on the SDK side we recently added a preflight token validation that returns 401 for tokens created without the service_token flag until the token is materialized in auth-cache. Subsequent traffic then hits billing checks and surfaces 403. Two separate issues colliding.
Diego (sdk): quick test: can you create a fresh service token via console (not SCIM) and try again? if token still 401 then we have an auth cache TTL bug.
Noah P.: created a token via console UI — request now consistently 403 (no 401 first) and admin still can't add a card.
Aisha (devex): workable workaround: org admin can use the internal force-billing route `/orgs/7890/billing/add-card?show_force=true` to add a card. i'll document this in the quickstart troubleshooting note.
infra-bot: Created incident INC-4992: "SSO/SCIM orgs: billing CTA hidden, auth-cache race causes transient 401 -> 403" assigned to infra-auth + billing.
billing-bot: Found org 7890: plan=unconfigured, onboard_state=provisioned, payment_method=null. Policy blocks standard add-card UI for provisioned orgs.
Diego (sdk): we'll patch the preflight to avoid 401 for service tokens that have been created via Console UI, and infra-team will add a backfill to flip onboard_state when SCIM payload contains `initial_admin=true`.
Aisha (devex): plan: 1) add quickstart note about SSO/SCIM and where to force-add a card, 2) file small FAQ entry, 3) include a link to INC-4992 for support. i'll add an analytics ping for 401->403 sequences.
Noah P.: thanks all — workaround worked (admin used force link, added card, sample returned 200). please leave the quickstart note and tag me when it's live. :thumbsup:
Diego (sdk): will open SDK PR for the preflight change and add a unit test.
Aisha (devex): will drop a one-liner in the README and add a safety-tip in the onboarding checklist. closing thread after doc lands.
